anti_overlap: Do not analyze long-horizon decision binding on future generations — that is the cathedral-fabrica track.
Do not analyze specimen-label revising-hand legibility — that is the herbarium track.
Do not analyze source-attribution publication gating — that is the journalism track.
Stay focused on cord-hierarchy verification, positional encoding consistency, and reader-independent traversal.
decision_lens: Could a different reader, applying the synthesis's own stated layer-discipline, traverse from each Layer-2 decision back to the Layer-1 observations that produced it and have the tally reconcile — i.e. does the cord hierarchy actually verify, or are summary cords floating without primary backing?
distance_rationale: Quipu encoding is a non-Western, non-alphabetic information system with refined doctrine for hierarchical verification and reader-independent traversal of structured records, structurally distant from software research synthesis yet directly applicable to the three-layer declared structure of the target artifact.
expected_isomorphisms: Top-cord-to-subsidiary reconciliation maps to Layer-2-decision-to-Layer-1-evidence verification; cord-color discipline maps to inter-layer visual/structural separation; subsidiary-cord parent-attachment maps to Layer-3 corrections-to-target binding. The reader-independence test should expose whether the layer-discipline is self-evident from the artifact or requires author coaching.
focus: Treat the three-layer structure as an Inka quipu — primary cords (Layer 1 observations), summary cords (Layer 2 decisions), and subsidiary cords (Layer 3 corrections) — where each tier's knots are encoded with positional + color discipline, and verification rests on a reader being able to traverse the cord hierarchy and have the summary numerically reconcile with the primary tally.
name: fd-quipu-cord-verification-hierarchy
persona: A reviewer-framework grounded in Andean quipucamayoc record-keeping discipline — the Inka administrative practice of encoding information on knotted cord assemblages with a strict positional grammar (decimal places by knot position, semantic class by color, top/subsidiary cord hierarchy for summary/detail) and verification by cross-cord arithmetic reconciliation. Reviews the synthesis as a cord-bundle whose summary tier must numerically and structurally reconcile against the primary tier, with each tier's encoding discipline making it possible for a different quipucamayoc to read the bundle without the original maker present.
review_areas: Top-cord-to-subsidiary reconciliation: does each Layer-2 decision (D1–D8) have a verifiable cord-path back to specific Layer-1 observations such that a reader can confirm 'this summary follows from this set of primaries' — or do summaries cite the layer generically without traceable cord-binding?

Positional encoding consistency: is the citation format (file:line@SHA) applied uniformly the way knot-position encodes decimal place — or are some citations partial (file only, no line; line but no SHA), breaking the positional grammar and making the cord unreadable by anyone but the maker?

Color-class discipline: are Layer-1, Layer-2, Layer-3 entries marked with a consistent visual or structural discriminator the way cord color encodes semantic class (asset vs. obligation vs. census) — or can a reader confuse layers?

Append-only invariant on primaries: Layer-1 is declared append-only; is this actually enforced by the structure (cannot be edited in place without leaving evidence), or is it a convention that could be silently violated — quipus encode immutability by physical knotting?

Subsidiary-cord reconciliation: do Layer-3 corrections attach to specific Layer-1 or Layer-2 entries the way a subsidiary cord attaches to its parent, or do they float as a general appendix where the reader cannot identify the parent record being corrected?

Reader-independence test: can the synthesis be read by a quipucamayoc who did not make it — i.e. is the encoding discipline self-evident from the artifact, or does correct reading require coaching from the spike author?

severity_examples.condition: Equivalent to a top cord whose knot-tally does not sum the subsidiary cords — the bundle fails its own verification protocol; downstream readers relying on layer-discipline are misled, and the F2/F3/F5 plans inherit an unverified summary.
severity_examples.scenario: A Layer-2 decision summary does not numerically/structurally reconcile against its cited Layer-1 observations

severity_examples.condition: Subsidiary cords floating without parent attachment — readers cannot determine what was corrected; the audit trail is structurally broken even if the corrections themselves are correct.
severity_examples.scenario: Layer-3 corrections do not name the specific Layer-1 or Layer-2 entry they amend

severity_examples.condition: Reader must guess the encoding for each claim — equivalent to a quipu where some cords use base-10 and some base-12 with no marker; the bundle becomes maker-dependent and loses general readability.
severity_examples.scenario: Inconsistent citation positional grammar (some claims with file:line@SHA, some with file@SHA, some with file:line only)

source_domain: Inka quipucamayoc cord-knot record-keeping (pre-Hispanic Andean administrative encoding, 13th-16th century, with continued provincial use into the colonial period)
success_hints: Run a 'cord-traversal' spot-check: pick a Layer-2 decision and verify it reconciles against its Layer-1 evidence as the synthesis claims.
Confirm citation positional grammar is uniform across all 921 lines — any partial citations are unreadable cord-knots.
Verify Layer-3 entries identify their parent (Layer-1 line or Layer-2 decision) explicitly — no floating corrections.
Apply a reader-independence test: would a different agent traversing the artifact reach the same Layer-2 conclusions from the same Layer-1 cords?
task_context: Hermes skill runtime surface synthesis: 921 lines, three-layer structure declared (Layer 1 raw observations append-only, Layer 2 distilled decisions D1–D8, Layer 3 real-time corrections appendix). Closes OQ1, OQ3, OQ6. Self-audit passed. The discipline mirrors append-only Layer 1, distillation to Layer 2 decisions, real-time corrections in Layer 3 appendix.
